Look for the DXIL validator diagnostic "Instructions must be of an allowed type" at the
`insertvalue %dx.types.fouri32 ...` note (both DXC panes) -- this is the malformed IR the
issue reports for `WaveMatch` on a vector argument under `-Od` (optimizations disabled).
The Clang pane does not reach that code at all: it rejects the shader with
"use of undeclared identifier 'WaveMatch'" -- Clang's HLSL front end has not implemented the
intrinsic yet, so it cannot show whether it would scalarize the argument correctly.
